data.text:
Mohmmad Anwar Khan And Another vs The State Of
Maharashtra And Another on 9 May, 2024 
 -1-
 914-Aba.651.2024 
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
 914 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 651 Of 2024
 Mohmmad Anwar Khan And Another
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra And Another
 ...
Advocate for Applicants : Mr. Suniket Kulkarni & Ms. Rutuja L. Jakhade
App for Respondent - State : Mr. D. R. Karde
 ...
 Coram : Abhay S. Waghwase, J.
 Dated : 9th May, 2024
Per Court :
1. Heard.
2.  Learned advocate for applicants pointed out that,
applicants are not named in the FIR.
3. Perused the FIR. After considering the submissions advanced, prosecution needs to be heard. Therefore, till papers are received, interim protection as prayed deserves to be granted. 
Hence, the following order :-
 ORDER (i) Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 14.06.2024. Learned APP waives notice for respondent nos.1 and 2 - State.
914 - ABA.651.2024 Mohmmad Anwar Khan And Another vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 9 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38512409/
1 (ii) Till the next date, in the event of arrest of applicants, namely, (i) Mohammad Anwar Khan and (ii) Abdul Hanif Abdul Aajij in connection with C.R. No.60 of 2024, registered with Shirpur City Police Station, Dist. Dhule for offence punishable under Sections 26(2)(iv), 27(3)
(d), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a), 3 read with section 59(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act and under sections 188, 272, 273, 328 read with section 34 of Indian Penal Code, they be released on executing Personal Bond and Surety Bond of Rs.15,000/- each, with one surety each in the like amount. 
(iii) Applicants shall attend concerned police station on every Monday and Thursday of every month between 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon and shall co-operate in the investigation. 
(iv) Applicants shall not tamper prosecution evidence.
